name: clickhouse
description: Connect ClickHouse Cloud to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use ClickHouse Cloud MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect ClickHouse Cloud to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with read-only ClickHouse Cloud queries using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my ClickHouse Cloud workspace.
Find anything in ClickHouse Cloud that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review read-only ClickHouse Cloud queries in ClickHouse Cloud.
